    Title: General rule
    Definition: Ladders shall be used only on stable and level surfaces unless secured to prevent accidental displacement.
    Source: 1926.1053(b)(6)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: General rule
    Definition: The area around the top and bottom of ladders shall be kept clear.
    Source: 1926.1053(b)(9)
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: General rule
    Definition: When ascending or descending a ladder, the user shall face the ladder.
    Source: 1926.1053(b)(20)
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: General rule
    Definition: Each employee shall use at least one hand to grasp the ladder when progressing up and/or down the ladder.
    Source: 1926.1053(b)(21)
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: General rule
    Definition: An employee shall not carry any object or load that could cause the employee to lose balance and fall.
    Source: 1926.1053(b)(22)
